There is more involved to providing accurate, practical, and visually appealing maps than just drawing lines where roads are. To this end, we have spent a lot of time collecting topographical information for the entire planet, and presenting it in an intuitive and practical way.  If there is a small hill or valley in the area you are interested in looking at, it will likely be obvious in Mapster. Of course, there is a lot more to Mapster than just a visualization of the terrain in an area.  We use data from the OpenStreetMap project to be able to show you where roads, trails, stores, coffee shops, and hundreds of different types of features can be located.  Approximately a billion points make up the current OpenStreetMap data set, and the collection is continuing to grow at an astounding rate.
    
Mapster doesn't rely on mapping data that quickly becomes outdated.  Approximately once per month, our servers update the map information with the latest changes submitted by hundreds of thousands of users around the world, and keep your iPhone, iPod, or iPad current automatically.  As a Mapster user, you obtain privileged access to incredible maps of our entire planet, at a level of detail never before seen.
    
By using your device's built-in ability to determine its location (through a combination of GPS, cell phone triangulation, and WiFi site analysis technologies), you'll always know what's "around the next corner".
